Coram : G.S. SINGHVI*, A.K. GANGULY
Service Law - Seniority - lnter-se seniority of direct recruits - Determination of - Held: Seniority is an incidence A B of service and where the service rules prescribe the method c of its computation, it is squarely governed by such rules - In absence of a rule governing seniority, an executive gap - Only in the absence of a rule or executive instructions, the court may have to evolve a fair and just principle of seniority, which could be applied in D the facts and circumstances of the case - In the instant case, no record has been brought before the Court to ascertain merit wise
Decision Date : 09-08-2011 | Case No : CIVIL APPEAL No. 7002/2004 | Disposal Nature : Appeal(s) allowed | Bench : 2 Judges
